operations.method: First sweep of the three fronts added in SOP v2 (recurrence-vs-depth, physical/analog computation theory, compositional/categorical models). 3 scoped web queries; material candidates verified by fetching primary-source abstracts (arXiv abstract pages, PMC full text).
operations.result: MATERIAL (3 sources, admitted as ev-000000000012, proposal ep_7f903db1): arXiv:2607.10110 Looped Mamba (depth-recurrence substitutes for depth iso-param/iso-FLOPs; addresses prob:recurrence-vs-depth-substitution); arXiv:2605.30757 memory-budget separation (compressed loops bounded by recurrent-state size, cannot decide P-complete under logspace; persistent mutable memory as central test-time resource; addresses prob:recurrence-depth-scaling and prob:persistent-volumetric-state-material); Whitelam 2026 PNAS PMC13056118 (gradient-descent training of noise-driven thermodynamic computers, MNIST 92% top-1 at ~95% of teacher, >7 orders energy advantage; addresses prob:entropy-qualified-not-trainable). NEGATIVE: compositional/categorical front — only ACT 2026 conference announcements. Follow-up: the memory-budget separation directly supports the VRC persistent-state thesis and suggests the kerr-capacity instrument should treat persistent mutable state size as the binding resource, not iteration count.
